principle.name: Page Object Model Pattern
principle.description: Always create Page Object classes that encapsulate page elements and interactions. Each page object should represent a logical page or component in the application.
principle.rationale: POM provides maintainability, reusability, and clear separation between test logic and UI structure.

example.good: Create LoginPage class with methods like login(), verify_loaded(), navigate()
example.bad: Direct locator access in test functions without abstraction

principle.name: Web-First Assertions
principle.description: Use Playwright's web-first assertions that auto-wait for elements. Prefer expect(page.locator()).to_be_visible() over manual waits.
principle.rationale: Auto-waiting eliminates flaky tests and reduces test execution time.

principle.name: FN Documentation Headers
principle.description: Every test file and Page Object class must include FN: docstring headers following the Agentic Class Method pattern.
principle.rationale: Enables AI agents to quickly understand test structure without reading full implementation.

convention.rule: Group related tests in describe/test blocks
convention.template:
# FN:test_login_flow.py """ FN:test_login_flow.py Contains 1 class. Tests for the Login Flow.
Primary: TestLoginFlow.test_login_page_load
Classes: - TestLoginFlow: Test suite for Login Flow (lines 20-60)
Functions: - FN:test_login_page_load: Verify login page loads (lines 26-38) """
class TestLoginFlow: """FN:TestLoginFlow - Test suite for Login Flow."""
def test_login_page_load(self, page: Page, base_url: str): """FN:test_login_page_load - Verify login page loads.""" # Test implementation

convention.rule: Avoid XPath and CSS selectors when possible

pitfall.why_problematic: Hardcoded waits make tests slow and flaky. Elements may load faster or slower.
pitfall.correct_approach: Use Playwright's auto-waiting assertions that wait for elements to be in expected state.

pitfall.why_problematic: Tests break when UI implementation changes but functionality remains same.
pitfall.correct_approach: Test user-visible behavior and outcomes, not internal states.

pitfall.why_problematic: Tests depend on specific data state that may change.
pitfall.correct_approach: Use fixtures to set up test data and clean up after tests.
